title: Agent workflow
description: OpenGuildKit rules for scoping, reviewing and approving agent-assisted work.

rules.instruction: Confirm the intended outcome, affected components and acceptance criteria with the requester before editing.
rules.verification: Check that the task brief records the target behavior, boundaries and unresolved decisions.

rules.instruction: Ask the relevant boards to review the scoped change and bring conflicting recommendations to the decision owner.
rules.verification: Attach the review record and the owner's decisions to the change.

rules.instruction: Use the project owner's approved tools and data sources. Obtain explicit permission before publishing, deploying or making destructive changes.
rules.verification: Compare the work performed with the agreed scope and retain any approvals needed for external actions.

rules.instruction: Run the repository's relevant checks and record any gaps. Ask the designated reviewer to approve the result before merge.
rules.verification: Provide the commands, outcomes and reviewer decision with the proposed change.
